# reco_integrations (Data Source)

Lists all connected integrations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reco_integrations" "all" {}

output "connected_integration_names" {
  value = [for i in data.reco_integrations.all.integrations : i.app]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `integrations` (Attributes List) List of integrations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integrations))

<a id="nestedatt--integrations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integrations`

Read-Only:

- `app` (String) Data source / application identifier.
- `created_on` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `error_details` (String) Error details if integration is unhealthy.
- `has_new_endpoints` (Boolean) Whether new endpoints are available.
- `instance_id` (String) Integration instance ID.
- `last_updated_by` (String) User who last updated the integration.
- `last_updated_on` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `severity_config` (String) Severity configuration.
- `status` (String) Integration status.
